responsibility: Declares NameResolutionContext, the central mutable state holder for the Rust Resolver2_0 pipeline. It owns one ForeverStack per namespace, a reference to Analysis::Mappings, helper APIs for inserting definitions and shadowable imports into a chosen namespace, scoped-execution helpers that create and remove ribs during AST traversal, and the resolution map that records which usage NodeIds were bound to which definition NodeIds across the early and late passes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the mutable NameResolutionContext data structure, including its ForeverStack members for values, types, macros, and labels, plus the insert/scoped/map_usage APIs; the paired .cc file implements those namespace-dispatch, scoping, and lookup operations.
